steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: So, if we want to blow up the slide and rebuild the railway, we'll have to convince the business representative, Croque Diamondface; the industry representative, Deculture Silvermint; as well as that Catch guy?

steps.name: Stitch Canvas
steps.text: Yes, they hold the most prominent positions, and most Durins will cast their votes depending on their movements.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: And why can't you do this yourself?

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: I see, you must not be very popular around here.

steps.name: Stitch Canvas
steps.text: Would it kill you to sugar-coat it a little bit?

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Seems like a major pain in the tail. But whatever, I'll treat it like a good deed for Acahualla.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: So where can I find them?

steps.name: Stitch Canvas
steps.text: Phew, it's finally over. That Gavial is pretty scary.

steps.name: Edge Eartheart
steps.text: Seems like you're on the right path though, finally.

steps.name: Stitch Canvas
steps.text: Are you happy now, Edge?

steps.name: Edge Eartheart
steps.text: To be honest, I'm not sure I'm ready to part with the Great Aquapit.

steps.name: Stitch Canvas
steps.text: Hah! Whose fault is it that the damned thing's sitting in the middle of the railway? Otherwise I really wouldn't have been able to find a single person willing to knock that thing down!

steps.name: Edge Eartheart
steps.text: Yeah, but I did just have an idea. It's been more than half a year since the dome broke and the waterfall started coming down.

steps.name: Edge Eartheart
steps.text: Everyone's been having a great time, but I'm sure they're starting to get tired of it.

steps.name: Edge Eartheart
steps.text: Why don't we take this opportunity to build something brand new? I think you were talking to Catch about a super water cannon or something, and it's on everyone's lips now!

steps.name: Edge Eartheart
steps.text: And I'm not gonna lie, I'm also a little intrigued...

steps.name: Stitch Canvas
steps.text: ...*sigh*.

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: That Archosauria woman! Brutish, uncouth, impetuous, and presumptuous! Can you believe it, Croque? I was having a bit of writer's block, so I went up to the caves to harvest some wild tea and relax...

steps.name: Croque Diamondface
steps.text: And someone scooped you up and jumped off the top of the waterfall.

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: Utterly unthinkable.

steps.name: Croque Diamondface
steps.text: Regrettably, I'm afraid that no ordinary Zeruertzan would be able to resist the seduction of that story. If it were put to paper, it would become an overnight sensation.

steps.name: Croque Diamondface
steps.text: 'You can trust me.' 'Avdotya, hold on tight.' Ahh, it hits all those passionate notes.

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: Forget it!

steps.name: Croque Diamondface
steps.text: It certainly beats your umpteenth story about the snow.

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: Speaking of which, a couple days ago, a few kids came by to talk to me about those short stories. I thought I was finally getting some readers...

steps.name: Croque Diamondface
steps.text: What'd they have to say?

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: 'Really funny. I want to see what happens next.'

steps.name: Croque Diamondface
steps.text: I knew it.

steps.name: Croque Diamondface
steps.text: Avdotya, they didn't mean any harm. It's just that we Durins have no way of relating to your experiences.

steps.name: Croque Diamondface
steps.text: How long did it take for me to finally understand a sliver of your background? Let's not even talk about ordinary Durins.

steps.name: Croque Diamondface
steps.text: None of us have seen real snow, let alone the kind that you describe... How do you pronounce those words again? 'Chiaroscuro'? 'Ephemeral'?

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: It'd be better if those words only existed in literature.

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: Regardless, I'm happy with my life now. I don't try to control anyone, nobody tries to control me. There are no terror plots brewing behind the scenes, no risk of getting framed, no getting dragged into an assassination.

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: I write a few ads and design a few signs for our shopping district, and that's enough to keep me fed. What more could I ask for?

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: I spend my days bathing beneath the sun on my recliner. Sure, it might be an artificial light source, but that's enough for me.

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: I was hoping these tranquil days would continue forever, until...

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Is this the office of the business representative, Croque Diamondface?

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Hello, I want to blow up that big slide.

steps.name: Croque Diamondface
steps.text: ...*sigh*.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Yo, Avdotya, fancy seeing you here!

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: She doesn't look too good.

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: Sorry, Croque, I'm afraid I have to excuse myself.

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: I need to head back and perform some maintenance on my crossbow.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Did I do something to make her mad?

steps.name: Croque Diamondface
steps.text: Ahem... Are you the guests who just arrived in Zeruertza? I heard Catch talking about you earlier.

steps.name: Croque Diamondface
steps.text: I must say, his assessment of the situation was on the nose.

steps.name: Croque Diamondface
steps.text: 'A merry bunch more Durin than Durins.'

steps.name: Strange Machine
steps.text: Evasive maneuvers! Evasive maneuvers!

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: Hmm, what a weird design. Couldn't be more different from Lancet-2.

steps.name: Strange Machine
steps.text: Please stay back!

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: Doesn't seem as smart as her, but it does share some of her same basic reactions. Wonder how this thing works?

steps.name: Strange Machine
steps.text: Danger level: high! Stay back, stranger.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: Take it easy, little fella. My name's Zumama. I'm not going to hurt you.

steps.name: Strange Machine
steps.text: Defining identity, Zumama.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: What's your name?

steps.name: Strange Machine
steps.text: Attributes: Model R3-E3 assistant robot, number 0429, for the glory of serving the Durin people.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: Hi there, 0429. Is there something wrong with your shock absorber system? You're wobbling all over the place.

steps.name: Strange Machine #0429
steps.text: Self-inspection report: End of service life: approaching. Original components: aging.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: I can help. Look, I have a whole set of maintenance tools.

steps.name: Strange Machine #0429
steps.text: Overhaul... Determining probability of success: low. R3-E3 will be scrapped after service life ends.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: From what I've seen, little fella, there's nothing major wrong with you. Probably nothing a few screws can't fix, so don't give up on yourself just yet.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: You're a cutie, so I'd like to help you. How about it?

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: We can be friends.

steps.name: Strange Machine #0429
steps.text: Friends? Unable to comprehend: friend.

steps.name: Strange Machine #0429
steps.text: You can help me conduct an overhaul?

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: Sure can.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: But I'll have to open up your shell first.

steps.name: Strange Machine #0429
steps.text: No. Requesting mission cancellation, requesting mission cancellation. Danger, danger!

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: Don't run away! It'll be fine!

steps.name: Durin Passerby
steps.text: Did I just see a surface-dweller Phidia chasing after an assistant robot?

steps.name: Durin Passerby
steps.text: Well that's odd. Did I drink too much yesterday?

steps.name: Durin Passerby
steps.text: Speaking of which, Avdotya writes about this kind of stuff, doesn't she? About 'chasing and killing' and whatnot, even if I can't understand half of it.

steps.name: Durin Passerby
steps.text: Well, uh, I guess I'm starting to get why she keeps saying it's not meant to be a comedy.

steps.name: Croque Diamondface
steps.text: Care for some tea, Miss Inam?

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: So, Durins actually do have non-alcoholic drinks.

steps.name: Croque Diamondface
steps.text: Everyone needs a change of pace every now and then. Plus, ahem, I AM still at work, after all. I prefer to drink on my own time.

steps.name: Croque Diamondface
steps.text: You suggested we talk one-on-one.

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: I have no doubts about Gavial's skills in a fight, but I don't think her fists will be very helpful here.

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: After all, we're not so different. You, the business representative of Zeruertza, and I.

steps.name: Croque Diamondface
steps.text: I see that you're the type to talk trade. Fine by me, I'm on board.

steps.name: Croque Diamondface
steps.text: Zeruertza is just a small Durin settlement. A few years ago, when we were still connected to the other cities, I did have a semblance of a job as the business representative.

steps.name: Croque Diamondface
steps.text: But ever since the last earthquake, our sole railroad has been cut off. Zeruertza is fortunate enough to be self-sufficient, the citizens aren't the neediest and there's been little urgency to restore our ties with the outside.

steps.name: Croque Diamondface
steps.text: Nowadays, my job is little more than catering to the whims of Zeruertza's populace and pushing out a few entertainment activities.

steps.name: Croque Diamondface
steps.text: Throw my weight around with the hawkers near the Great Aquapit, advertise some self-driving cart parts. It's a leisurely life.

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: I don't know much about Durin philosophy, but does 'not being the neediest' normally mean getting piss drunk and going surfing?

steps.name: Croque Diamondface
steps.text: Pretty much.

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: But if you asked anyone up on the surface...

steps.name: Croque Diamondface
steps.text: Pretty much. By our standards, that's not very needy.

steps.name: Croque Diamondface
steps.text: So, it doesn't matter what terms Stitch laid out for you. If you want me to go along with your plan to blow up the water slide, you'll have to come up with something that'll impress me.

steps.name: Croque Diamondface
steps.text: No business gets done until both sides find the deal amenable.

steps.name: Croque Diamondface
steps.text: What can you offer Zeruertza's economy? Acahuallan artifacts aren't enough.

steps.name: Croque Diamondface
steps.text: I heard some sharp self-driving cart dealers already used your grand entrance to generate some excitement for their wares, but that's not enough either.

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: You... understand the way we do things on the surface better than I expected.

steps.name: Croque Diamondface
steps.text: Though I haven't been up there surface myself, the library we have here in the city isn't just for show.

steps.name: Croque Diamondface
steps.text: I am familiar with your customs.

steps.name: Croque Diamondface
steps.text: The Acahuallans dance around a Metal Crab without sleep or rest, and the last one standing becomes the Great Chief. Isn't that right?

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: Where did you hear that?

steps.name: Croque Diamondface
steps.text: I read it in 'Stranger Things.' It's the most popular periodical in Zeruertza. Back in the day, a great adventurer brought a whole big set down from the surface. It's basically our encyclopedia of the surface world.

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: That's just a lousy tabloid!

steps.name: Croque Diamondface
steps.text: Surely you're mistaken... You have no idea how diligently I studied Sargonian to be able to read those books.

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: No wonder your accent sounds almost native.

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: Welp, there goes my motivation all of a sudden. I feel like I could probably just bribe you with the last few issues of 'Stranger Things.'

steps.name: Croque Diamondface
steps.text: The most recent ones? There are sequels to those books?! Hmm... If you really could procure those, then maybe I could consider it...

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: I can hook you up with some good stuff.

steps.name: Croque Diamondface
steps.text: What is this?

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: A videotape. Want to take a look?

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: Found you.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Oh, Avdotya, what a coincidence. Are you here to enjoy the scenery again?

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: Be frank with me — why did you people come here?

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Miss Inam said she'd handle the discussions with Miss Croque, so the rest of us came out here to find Zumama.

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: That's not what I mean. Why did you surface people come down into our city? What's your real purpose?

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: I've been guarding the Super Convenient Lift-o-Matic #1 for a long time. Where's the main battalion backing you? Have Sargon's lords ameer finally taken an interest in the wealth underground?

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: This city doesn't have the loot you want. Leave, unless you want to poison this peaceful little city with bloodshed.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: I told you, this is a misunderstanding. Stitch was trying to find someone to help him repair the railway, and tricked us into coming here.

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: You mean you're his slave labor? And you're okay with that?

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Hey.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: That guy was acting like the sky was falling at the time, and Tomimi added her own creative touch... *sigh*, I was worried half to death, Zumama was up all night prepping for a tough fight, and we rushed over as fast as we could.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: *sniffle*... Sorry, I just wanted Gavial to take some time off...

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Well, it worked out... I guess I'll take this opportunity for a little vacation.

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: So... You people really don't have any ill intent? You weren't ordered by some noble to ransack the town?

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Believe me or not. Your call.

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: You do have a point... Even Sargon wouldn't ask someone as rude as you to serve them.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Rude? I just don't like wasting my breath.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: My plan's simple and straightforward. Help out that little runt Stitch, pick up some useful tech for us Tiacauh, and then go home. That's all.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: There's still a bunch of patients back at Rhodes Island waiting for me to check on 'em.

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: You're telling me you're a doctor?

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: What, do I not look the part? I'm licensed and everything.

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: If Miss Tomimi here said that she was a doctor, I'd be half-inclined to believe her for a few seconds.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Oh, I can be a doctor too! Gavial taught me anesthesia!

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Find the right spot, and then give it a good whack––

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Everyone at Rhodes Island calls it, uh, 'Gaviallic kinetic anesthesia.'

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: For crying out loud, it's a non-conventional modality. Even I rarely use it outside of extremely special circumstances.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: For example, when you've just run out of anesthesia and you lost your supply bag because you were beating the bad guys with it, stuff like that.

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: ––I think I'll keep an eye on you people after all.

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: Don't get any funny ideas. Zeruertza is my haven of peace, and I won't let you destroy it.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Go nuts.

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: I'll make sure you leave Zeruertza after doing what you said you're here to do.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Well, until then, why don't we check out the shops?

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Um, Miss Avdotya... You're from these parts, so would you mind showing us around Zeruertza?

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: Just a word of warning... If your plan is to case the city and map it, you'd give up on that.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: N-No, that's not it! What I mean is...

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: I absolutely love your outfit! Are there any Durin fashion outlets worth visiting? I... really want to go take a look!

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: Huh...?

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: Alright, if that's what you want... There are a few places worth going to.

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: Are you interested in seeing some Durin jewelry?

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: I am!!

steps.name: Catch Lightrace
steps.text: Stitch––

steps.name: Stitch Canvas
steps.text: What are you doing here, Catch?

steps.name: Catch Lightrace
steps.text: You used to always lock yourself in your room. What's the occasion?

steps.name: Stitch Canvas
steps.text: Look, even I want to catch some rays every now and then. Surely you didn't come all the way out here just to say that?

steps.name: Catch Lightrace
steps.text: You're trying to blow up my slide, and you're not even going to let me talk to you?

steps.name: Stitch Canvas
steps.text: ...Hmph. So you know.

steps.name: Catch Lightrace
steps.text: Master Edge told me.

steps.name: Stitch Canvas
steps.text: That decrepit old... Are you here to get a confession out of me?

steps.name: Catch Lightrace
steps.text: Actually, I'm not opposed to it. This summer has gone on far too long.

steps.name: Catch Lightrace
steps.text: And as architects, our best work is always the next project, right?

steps.name: Stitch Canvas
steps.text: Gah. I hate that part of you more than anything else.

steps.name: Catch Lightrace
steps.text: Which?

steps.name: Stitch Canvas
steps.text: You don't have a single serious bone in your body.

steps.name: Catch Lightrace
steps.text: Hahaha, I'll take that as the highest compliment!

steps.name: Catch Lightrace
steps.text: I'll agree to whatever you want with the slide, on the condition that we talk about the dome.

steps.name: Stitch Canvas
steps.text: What's there to talk about?

steps.name: Catch Lightrace
steps.text: Let's go take a walk. You should experience the Great Aquapit for yourself before deciding whether to blow it up, no?

steps.name: Croque Diamondface
steps.text: Do you have more? Where can I get the next one?!

steps.name: Croque Diamondface
steps.text: Pwaaah! That's the good stuff! Inam, want me to pour you some more?

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: I still haven't finished mine...

steps.name: Croque Diamondface
steps.text: C'mon, hurry it up~

steps.name: Croque Diamondface
steps.text: It's a shame Team Red Wine and Coffee didn't win the championship! Ahh, they were just one step away from that ship!

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: You seem to be enjoying yourself.

steps.name: Croque Diamondface
steps.text: I must admit, you surface-dwellers lead slightly more interesting lives than I imagined!

steps.name: Croque Diamondface
steps.text: What is this a recording of?

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: The Dossoles Warrior Championship. It's an old video I got from a friend who runs a caravan.

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: I heard something happened there not too long ago, and I don't know if the event has been held these last few years.

steps.name: Croque Diamondface
steps.text: Ahhhh! I want to see more! I want to see the losers make a comeback next year!

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: Croque, even the most boring form of recreation can become quite stimulating if you spice things up with a bit of competition.

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: You cheer for the team you support while chugging ale with your friends. I don't think any Durin would be able to turn down this lifestyle.

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: Plus, alcohol and fast food sales generally double during a competition. How about it? I think it'd fit the Durins like a glove.

steps.name: Croque Diamondface
steps.text: Alcohol sells well enough in this city, and I doubt there's any need to hold a competition to stimulate those sales.

steps.name: Croque Diamondface
steps.text: That said, hmm... From the perspective of fun and entertainment, there is a certain appeal.

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: Let me say this to you straight, business representative.

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: Want to build a super water racetrack?
